tests/run.sh:11 — bash "$VALIDATOR" ... invoked against the unchecked path, failing opaquely

findings.label: duplication
findings.failure_mode: The exact-match five-heading presence loop already exists hand-written in build-artifacts.sh (lines 52-55, present before this diff). This diff adds a second, independently hand-typed copy of the same loop in validate-pack.sh instead of extracting it into one sourced function. The two copies already word their outcome differently and will keep drifting silently if the required-heading list ever changes in one script but not the other.
evidence: .claude/skills/pr-review/scripts/build-artifacts.sh:52 — for h in the five heading strings (first hand-written copy of the check)
